Congratulations @ITUSecGen Doreen Bogdan-Martin on reelection as @ITU Secretary-General!  Having worked with Doreen during my service in the Biden Administration as NTIA’s Deputy Assistant Secretary at Commerce, I found her to be a transformational leader.  The first woman to ever serve in the Secretary General role, she made great strides on ITU modernization, strengthening transparency and accountability, building industry partnerships, and expanding global connectivity. 

Looking forward to seeing her build upon that progress in the term to come!

As we wrap up Veterans Day, I want to take a special moment to highlight a remarkable member of my own team.  If you have ever visited my office in Frederick, you have likely had the pleasure of meeting Edena Bradford, my incredible Director of Constituent Services. Before joining our team, Edena served in the United States Navy for 13 years as an Operation Specialist.  Joining the Navy right out of high school, Edena answered the call to serve our nation and provide humanitarian aid across the globe. Her service took her overseas to Italy, Africa, the Middle East, and Japan.  When her time in the military came to an end, her heart for service did not. Edena knew she wanted to continue giving back to her country, and she jumped at the opportunity to join my office to help constituents in our community who are in need.  I am incredibly proud to have her on my staff. Thank you, Edena, for your unwavering dedication and continued service to this great nation—and a profound thank you to all our veterans today.

This Veterans Day, we honor all who wore the uniform to defend our country and democracy.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
